systems.platform: paper forms in three copies, passed from kebele to woreda to ICS

systems.system: Regional and federal digital civil registration pilots
systems.country_label: digital home-grown (Oromia and Amhara) and open-source (federal and Addis Ababa) technologies
systems.platform: home-grown in Oromia and Amhara; open-source at federal level and in Addis Ababa
systems.tiers: piloted in different parts of the country; government has decided to standardise one digital system nationally

note: A July 2025 presentation on civil registration: it says registration is mainly paper-based, with forms carried from kebele to woreda offices, and cites inadequate ICT infrastructure and power and network interruptions in general terms, but states nothing specific about whether woreda or kebele offices have a connection.
